summary: Five Nights at Freddy's entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Five Nights at Freddy's

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Windows PC at native desktop resolution

primary.why: The original PC release is the content and timing authority for Five Nights at Freddy's, and Steam remains the cleanest current PC route. Later mobile/console ports are accessibility routes, not required secondary content.
primary.how_to_play: Use the Steam Windows version with default presentation and record at native desktop resolution. Use mobile/console ports only for control comparison.

all_releases.reason: primary: best fidelity to original timing/presentation and current PC capture.
skip: useful control comparison, but no sourced exclusive story content over PC.

all_releases.platform: PlayStation / Xbox / Nintendo Switch console ports

all_releases.reason: skip: accessibility route, not the original timing/capture authority.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: No sourced platform-exclusive content split requires a secondary route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Later console/mobile ports may differ in controls or presentation; do not treat them as higher-completeness routes without a separate port audit.

entries.title: Five Nights at Freddy's: Security Breach
entries.definitive_edition: Current Steam PC release with Ruin DLC

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC build with DLC and settings documented

primary.version: Current Steam release with Ruin DLC installed
primary.why: Security Breach is a larger 3D FNaF entry and the PC release is the most flexible current route for high-resolution capture, patches, and the free Ruin story DLC. Console versions are useful fallback routes, but PC gives the clearest settings and patch documentation.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current Steam PC release and install Ruin if documenting complete story coverage. Record build, DLC state, graphics settings, route/ending, save slot, accessibility options, platform-exclusive bugs/fixes, and whether console performance was compared.

secondary.why: PC is the preferred capture/settings route.

all_releases.fidelity: Launch platform family with PC as best capture route.
all_releases.reason: primary: current, patchable, and settings-rich route.
primary: include for complete Security Breach story coverage.
secondary: access/platform comparison.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: Patch and DLC state matter; Ruin is free but must be installed and documented.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record ending route, patch, and DLC state; do not merge with Help Wanted or FNaF World.

entries.title: FNaF World
entries.definitive_edition: Official free Game Jolt build with Update 2 state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Official free PC build with exact update state documented

primary.version: Official Game Jolt release / Update 2 route
primary.why: FNaF World was removed from Steam shortly after launch, and the practical official route is Scott Cawthon's later free Game Jolt build with Update 2 content. That route should be labeled because it is not the original paid Steam launch build.
primary.how_to_play: Use the official free Game Jolt PC build. Record build/update, party, difficulty, mode, save state, Halloween/Update 2 content, chip/byte setup, and whether the withdrawn Steam launch version was excluded.

secondary.what_to_play: Use only if legally retained and documenting launch history.
secondary.why: The current official route is the free revised build.

all_releases.reason: secondary: history only; no normal current purchase route.
primary: practical official route after Steam withdrawal.
primary: document for a complete revised-build run.

fidelity_vs_completeness_conflict.note: The official current route is the revised free build, while the original Steam launch version is withdrawn.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not treat this RPG spinoff as a replacement for mainline FNaF horror entries.
